title: spec + server + ui: draft and publish events on the live change channel, so every open Studio follows writes from MCP, REST and other tabs (#32592 phase 2, ADR-0008)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ③ the maintainer's ruling C on #32592, phase 2. The verbatim is 「以上原则同意」 in the triage#1 session, answering decision batch #1, recorded on #32592. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

#32592 您裁了 C、分两期。第一期（Studio 回到页面时重取 + 低频轮询）已经在 ui 车道排队。这张是第二期：服务端把草稿和发布事件推到实时通道，所有开着的 Studio 页面实时跟上。按裁定，三件事齐了才开工，所以先挂起。

## What

Draft and publish events of metadata items go out on the live change channel that ADR-0008 describes (change log, subscription, SSE/WS broadcast). Studio subscribes, so a write from any writer (MCP, REST, another tab, another person) shows in every open Studio without a reload. Phase 1 polling stays as the disconnect fallback.

## Start conditions (all three, per the ruling)

1. Measure the scale-to-zero cost of persistent connections against the phase-1 poll (`hiddenTabPollStop` was made for this concern).
2. A rule for who may receive another user's draft events (an audience and permission face).
3. Amend ADR-0008 to cover draft and publish events and that audience rule.

## Lanes

`domain:spec` leads (event contract, ADR-0008 amendment). `domain:server` (fan-out; today draft events return early at `protocol-mutation-fan-out.ts` and `protocol-class-head.ts`) and `domain:ui` (subscription) follow.

Restart-when: the three start conditions above are met and recorded on this card (maintainer ruling C on #32592).
